title: "Research"
title-block-banner: var(--bs-secondary) url(images/recursos/network.jpg) no-repeat 50% 50% / cover
listing: 
- id: research
  contents: /research # all Quarto docs in the `posts` directory will be included on your listing page
  type: grid # or `default` or `table`; each type has its own set of yaml options to include
  sort: "date desc" # can also sort on more than one field
  categories: true # allows you to sort posts by assigned categories

- id: projects

      ip: "IP"
      funder.name: "Funder"
      started: "Start"
      ended: "End"
      funding: "Funding"
  categories: true
  sort-ui: [title, ip, funding, started, ended]
  filter-ui: true
  contents: 
    - "/research/projects.yml"
    - "/research/projects/**/*.qmd" 
format: 
  html:
    include-after-body: _includes/_footer.html
